donor_rule: Equal weight across other pricing-zone mean prices, same UPC and week; at least three other zones
zone_source: demo.dta: static zone mapping, historical changes unobserved
common_sample: Within packaging and period, OLS/AAC/other-zone share identical observations
outside_share: Recomputed for packaging universe BEFORE IV missingness screening; original traffic denominator
period_design: Full period and 1991-1992 motivated by GLS 2012; pooled stores, not their single-store replication
cautions: Same chain and Chicago region; not independent cities
Chain-wide brand-week promotions/demand shocks may invalidate price IV
Missing prices/donor assortment can depend on demand
No claim that significance or negative coefficient validates IV
